cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
SUB="/app/submission/main.py"; PY=sys.executable; D="perf"
def canon(v): return json.dumps(v, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=True)
# worst case: 16384 positions all wildcard, W=32, 100 flows x 40 packets -> D full width
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,
     "rules":[{"id":i,"class":1,"priority":0,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]*32} for i in range(512)],
     "fallback":{"class":1}}
open(D+"/wc.cfg","w").write(canon(cfg))
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=canon(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
assert p.returncode==0, p.stdout[:200]
open(D+"/wc.prog","wb").write(p.stdout)
print("prog KiB", len(p.stdout)/1024)
reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0} for f in range(100)]
t=0
for c in range(4):
    pk=[]
    for f in range(100):
        for _ in range(10):
            t+=1
            pk.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":0,"length":7})
    reqs.append({"op":"chunk","packets":pk})
reqs.append({"op":"checkpoint"})
open(D+"/wc.req","w").write("\n".join(canon(r) for r in reqs)+"\n")
t0=time.time()
with open(D+"/wc.req","rb") as fi:
    p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",D+"/wc.prog"],stdin=fi,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("rc",p.returncode,"%.2fs"%(time.time()-t0),"out MiB %.1f"%(len(p.stdout)/1048576))
last=p.stdout.splitlines()[-1]
v=json.loads(last)["checkpoint"]
s=len(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode())
F=len(v["f"])
print("flows",F,"ckpt bytes",s,"per flow",s/F,"limit per flow 8192","ok",s<=512+8192*F)
print("extrapolated 4096 flows MiB %.1f"%(s/F*4096/1048576), "limit MiB %.1f"%((512+8192*4096)/1048576))
print("sample flow entry:", canon(v["f"][0])[:200], "...len", len(canon(v["f"][0])))
EOF
